claude_proposed_widenings.name: level_up_grant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ASI is a permanent character-progression grant delivered at level-up, not an activated feature. It has no activation cost, no use count, and no reset cadence. The current 'activation' family for ClassFeatureMechanics requires all three. A new family (e.g. 'level_up_grant' or 'passive_grant') is needed to represent mechanics that apply permanently when the character reaches a certain class level.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants a feat (or an ability score increase, which is itself modeled as a feat per SRD 5.2.1). Neither GrantExtraActionEffect nor HealHpEffect covers this. The v4 taxonomy defers 'modify_ability_score' as out-of-scope; 'grant_feat' is the appropriate effect atom for level-up-granted feats.
